title: Asymptotic Castelnuovo-Mumford regularity of (co)homology modules involving powers of ideals
summary: Let $R$ be a Noetherian standard $\mathbb{N}$-graded ring, and let $I_1,\ldots,I_r$ be homogeneous ideals of $R$. Let $L,M$, and $N$ be finitely generated $\mathbb{Z}$-graded $R$-modules with $N\subseteq M$. For $\underline{n} :=(n_1,\dots,n_r)\in\mathbb N^r$, set ${\bf I}^{\underline{n}}:=I_1^{n_1}\cdots I_r^{n_r}$. We study the asymptotic behaviour of the (Castelnuovo-Mumford) regularity of two families of Ext and Tor modules: those obtained from the quotients ${\bf I}^{\underline{n}}M/{\bf I}^{\underline{n}}N$, and those obtained from the quotients $M/{\bf I}^{\underline{n}}N$, with $L$…
